verdict.rationale: Intuit's own SDKs and tooling document a public QuickBooks Online V3 REST API: the official PHP SDK has create/read/update/delete examples, the official OAuth 2.0 client handles token management, and the official MCP server covers full CRUD across 29 entity types and 11 reports. A sandbox/production environment split supports safe programmatic driving. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and llms.txt, direct API reference documentation in the evidence beyond SDK READMEs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
